theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_pp_key_inequality
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), 2 * hsNormSq (A - B) ≤ (1 + ‖A‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖B‖ ^ 2) * hsNormSq ((Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v)))).starProjection - (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v)))).starProjection)
